subject: DI02005021

body.en:
Definition

Comminution reduces solid size by applying forces that create fractures or abrasion; it increases area and liberates components.

Classification

  • Compression:jaw, gyratory, roll crushers; impact:hammer mill; impact/attrition:ball mill. Coarse crushing and fine grinding overlap by service.

Factors and selection

  • Hardness, toughness, abrasiveness, stickiness, moisture, heat sensitivity and contamination tolerance affect choice.
  • Feed size, required product distribution, reduction ratio, throughput, wet/dry operation and wear/energy cost must match.
  • Applications include mineral liberation, larger contact area and feed preparation; excess fines can create dust and downstream separation difficulties.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Comminutionમાં fracture/abrasionથી solidનું કદ ઘટે; area વધે તથા components મુક્ત થાય.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Compressionમાં jaw, gyratory, roll; impactમાં hammer; impact/attritionમાં ball mill. Coarse/fineની સીમા service પ્રમાણે બદલાય.

પરિબળો તથા પસંદગી

  • Hardness, toughness, abrasiveness, stickiness, moisture, heat sensitivity/contamination toleranceથી પસંદગી બદલાય.
  • Feed size, product distribution, reduction ratio, throughput, wet/dry તથા wear/energy cost મળતાં હોવા જોઈએ.
  • Mineral liberation, contact area વધારવા તથા feed preparationમાં ઉપયોગ; વધુ finesથી dust/downstream મુશ્કેલી.

body.en:
Definition

Specific energy is work per mass processed; power is the rate of work, so they require different units.

Explanation

  • Most input is dissipated as heat, deformation, vibration and losses; only part creates new surface. Empirical laws describe a stated material/size range.
  • If E is kWh/t and mass rate Q is t/h, net comminution P=EQ in kW. Specify tonne/short-ton basis consistently.
  • Motor input, idle input and useful shaft/fluid work are different bases. Add losses or efficiency only with a compatible energy definition; avoid double-counting.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Specific energy એટલે mass દીઠ work; power એટલે workનો સમયદીઠ દર, તેથી એકમો જુદા.

સમજણ

  • મોટાભાગની energy heat, deformation, vibration/lossમાં જાય; થોડો ભાગ નવી surface બનાવે. Empirical laws નિર્ધારિત range માટે છે.
  • E kWh/t અને Q t/h હોય તો net comminution P=EQ kW. Tonne/short-ton આધાર સમાન રાખો.
  • Motor input, idle input તથા useful shaft work જુદાં. Compatible basisમાં જ efficiency/loss ઉમેરો; double-counting નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Energy is proportional to the new surface produced, under the assumed size/surface relation.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume the same material and shape basis, with initial characteristic size F and final size P<F; E is positive specific reduction energy.
  2. Specific external surface varies as1/D.Rittinger assumes energy proportional to new surface, so dE=−KR dD/D²; the minus sign makes dE positive as size decreases.
  3. Integrate between the size limits:∫₀ᴱdE=−KR∫FᴾD⁻²dD.
  4. Since ∫D⁻²dD=−1/D, E=KR[1/D]Fᴾ=KR(1/P−1/F).
  5. Final law:E=KR(1/P−1/F).Determine KR=Etest/(1/Ptest−1/Ftest) from a compatible test; its unit includes the chosen length unit.
  6. At throughput Q in t/h and E in kWh/t, net model power Pnet=QE kW.The empirical fine-grinding model is not a universal efficiency relation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Size/surfaceની ધારણા હેઠળ energy નવી બનેલી surfaceના પ્રમાણમાં હોય.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. સમાન material/shape basisમાં initial F, final P<F; E positive specific reduction energy છે.
  2. Specific surface∝1/D; new surface પ્રમાણે energy હોવાથી dE=−KR dD/D².Size ઘટે ત્યારે dE positive કરવા minus sign છે.
  3. Size limits વચ્ચે integrate:∫₀ᴱdE=−KR∫FᴾD⁻²dD.
  4. ∫D⁻²dD=−1/D; તેથી E=KR[1/D]Fᴾ=KR(1/P−1/F).
  5. Final law:E=KR(1/P−1/F).Compatible testથી KR=Etest/(1/Ptest−1/Ftest); unitમાં chosen length unit સામેલ છે.
  6. Q t/h તથા E kWh/tમાં net model power Pnet=QE kW.Empirical fine-grinding model universal efficiency relation નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Energy per mass is proportional to the logarithm of the size reduction ratio.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume geometrically similar size reduction for the same material.Energy depends on size ratio; use F and P on the same diameter basis.
  2. Kick writes dE=−KK dD/D, so an equal fractional change in size needs equal model energy.
  3. Integrate:∫₀ᴱdE=−KK∫FᴾdD/D=−KK[lnD]Fᴾ.
  4. Therefore E=KK(lnF−lnP)=KK ln(F/P).The ratio is dimensionless and positive for F>P.
  5. Obtain KK=Etest/ln(Ftest/Ptest).For a new ratio R, Enew=KK lnR; do not use a base10 log with the same constant.
  6. Report energy per mass and then power=energy×mass rate.Kick is commonly used for coarse reduction within its tested range.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Mass દીઠ energy, size reduction ratioના logarithmના પ્રમાણમાં હોય.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. સમાન materialની geometrically similar reductionમાં energy size ratio પર છે; F/P સમાન diameter basis પર લો.
  2. Kick પ્રમાણે dE=−KK dD/D; સમાન fractional size change માટે સમાન model energy જોઈએ.
  3. Integrate:∫₀ᴱdE=−KK∫FᴾdD/D=−KK[lnD]Fᴾ.
  4. તેથી E=KK(lnF−lnP)=KK ln(F/P).F>Pમાં logarithm positive અને ratio નિરેક છે.
  5. KK=Etest/ln(Ftest/Ptest).નવા ratio R માટે Enew=KK lnR; સમાન constant સાથે base10 log નહીં વાપરવો.
  6. Energy per mass લખી power=energy×mass rate ગણો.Kick tested rangeની coarse reductionમાં સામાન્ય રીતે ઉપયોગી છે.

Definition

Bond’s model relates comminution energy to the inverse square-root change in a specified80%-passing size.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Bond uses an empirical intermediate size dependence:dE=−C dD/D^(3/2), for a stated material and test/circuit basis.
  2. Integrate:∫₀ᴱdE=−C∫FᴾD^(−3/2)dD=2C(1/√P−1/√F).Write KB=2C.
  3. Define work index Wi as the model specific energy from infinite feed size to100μm product.With sizes in μm, Wi=KB/√100=KB/10.
  4. Hence KB=10Wi and E=10Wi(1/√P80−1/√F80).Both F80 and P80 are80%-passing sizes in μm.
  5. Inverse form:Wi=E/[10(1/√P80−1/√F80)].E and Wi must use the same kWh per metric-tonne or short-ton convention.
  6. For Q on that mass basis, Pnet=QE.Work index is energy per mass, not motor power; state any corrections and do not mix arbitrary sieve means with80%-passing sizes.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bond modelમાં નિર્ધારિત80%-passing sizeના inverse square-root ફેરફારથી energy મળે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Bondનું empirical intermediate dependence dE=−C dD/D^(3/2), stated material/test-circuit basis માટે છે.
  2. Integrate:∫₀ᴱdE=−C∫FᴾD^(−3/2)dD=2C(1/√P−1/√F).KB=2C રાખો.
  3. Work index Wi એટલે model મુજબ infinite feedથી100μm productની specific energy.μm sizesમાં Wi=KB/√100=KB/10.
  4. અેથી KB=10Wi, E=10Wi(1/√P80−1/√F80).F80/P80 બંને80%-passing sizes μmમાં છે.
  5. Inverse form:Wi=E/[10(1/√P80−1/√F80)].E/Wiમાં metric-tonne કે short-ton convention સમાન રાખો.
  6. સમાન mass basisના Q માટે Pnet=QE.Work index energy/mass છે, motor power નહીં.Corrections જણાવો; arbitrary meansને80%-passing sizes સાથે ન ભેળવો.

body.en:
Definition

A crusher that breaks feed between a fixed jaw and a reciprocating jaw.

Principle

  • Intermittent compression fractures particles when the moving jaw approaches the fixed jaw.

Construction—detailed theory

The crushing chamber is a deep V-shaped space carried by a rigid frame (1). One side is a stationary jaw with a replaceable wear liner (2), while the other is a lined moving jaw (3). The wide upper opening accepts feed; the narrower opening at the bottom forms the discharge setting (6). This taper guides the material towards progressively smaller clearances.

An eccentric shaft and its linkage (4) convert rotary motion into jaw movement. A toggle/support arrangement (5) transmits the crushing force and supports the moving jaw; its exact arrangement differs between single- and double-toggle machines. Bearings, the guarded drive and a flywheel support operation and smooth the cyclic load. The discharge setting influences product size but does not produce particles of one exact size.

Working—detailed theory

Feed falls into the wide top of the chamber. During the closing part of the jaw cycle, the moving jaw approaches the fixed jaw and traps particles between the liners. Compressive stress rises until the particles fracture. Most crushing therefore occurs intermittently during the approach stroke, rather than continuously throughout a full revolution.

During the return stroke the jaw moves away, releasing the compressed bed. Gravity allows fragments to descend to a narrower region, where the next closing stroke breaks the larger pieces again. Successive compression and release continue until fragments can pass through the bottom opening. The product consequently has a distribution of sizes and may contain fines.

Uniform controlled feeding helps use the jaw width and reduces irregular loading. Jaw setting, feed properties and liner condition all affect capacity and size distribution. In an exam, connect the eccentric motion to the approach/return strokes and then to downward discharge; do not describe the jaw as making a continuous grinding rotation.

Applications

  • Primary coarse crushing of hard solids and preparation of feed for secondary mills.

Limitations and safety

  • Sticky/wet feed may choke; wear, noise and dust need engineered control. Guards/isolation are mandatory.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fixed તથા reciprocating jaw વચ્ચે feed તોડતું crusher.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Moving jaw નજીક આવે ત્યારે intermittent compressionથી fracture થાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

મજબૂત frame (1)માં ઊંડો V-shaped crushing chamber બને છે. એક બાજુ replaceable wear linerવાળો fixed jaw (2) અને સામે linerવાળો moving jaw (3) હોય છે. ઉપરનું પહોળું opening feed માટે અને નીચેનું સાંકડું opening discharge setting (6) માટે છે. આ ઉતરતી રચનાથી material આગળ વધતાં ઓછી clearanceમાં આવે છે.

Eccentric shaft તથા linkage (4) rotary motionને jawની હલનચલનમાં ફેરવે છે. Toggle/support (5) force પહોંચાડે અને moving jawને ટેકો આપે; single-/double-toggleમાં તેની ગોઠવણ જુદી હોય છે. Bearings, guarded drive અને flywheel cyclic loadને સંભાળે છે. Discharge settingથી product size પર અસર થાય, પરંતુ બધા particles એક જ sizeના થતા નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Feed ઉપરના પહોળા openingમાંથી chamberમાં પડે છે. Closing strokeમાં moving jaw fixed jawની નજીક આવે અને liners વચ્ચે particles પકડાય છે. Compressive stress fractureની મર્યાદા સુધી વધે ત્યારે particles તૂટે છે. તેથી crushing આખી revolution દરમિયાન સતત નહીં, પરંતુ મુખ્યત્વે approach strokeમાં થાય છે.

Return strokeમાં jaw દૂર જાય એટલે compressed bed ઢીલો પડે છે. Gravityથી fragments વધુ સાંકડા ભાગમાં ઊતરે; આગલા closing strokeમાં મોટા ટુકડા ફરી તૂટે છે. આ compression-release cycleથી fragments bottom openingમાંથી પસાર થઈ શકે ત્યાં સુધી crushing થાય છે. Productમાં વિવિધ sizes તથા fines રહે છે.

Controlled uniform feedથી jawની પહોળાઈ ઉપયોગમાં આવે અને irregular loading ઘટે છે. Jaw setting, feed properties તથા liner condition capacity/size distributionને અસર કરે છે. પરીક્ષામાં eccentric motionથી approach/return strokes અને પછી downward discharge સમજાવો; moving jaw સતત grinding rotation કરે એવું ન લખવું.

ઉપયોગો

  • Hard solidsનું primary coarse crushing તથા આગળના mill માટે feed.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Sticky/wet feedથી choking; wear, noise, dust માટે control. Guards/isolation જરૂરી.

body.en:
Definition

A continuous compression crusher with a gyrating mantle inside a fixed concave shell.

Principle

  • Eccentric movement alternately narrows and widens annular regions, crushing continuously around the circumference.

Construction—detailed theory

A fixed concave-lined shell (1) surrounds a conical crushing head or mantle (2), creating an annular crushing chamber. The mantle is mounted on a strong main shaft supported by the designed bearing arrangement (4). Feed enters the top around the shaft, while the annular lower opening (6) allows crushed material to leave. Replaceable liners protect the crushing surfaces.

An eccentric sleeve (3) drives the lower part of the shaft in a small circular path. This produces gyration of the mantle within the fixed concave; it is not simply a cone spinning about a stationary central position. The enclosed drive and lubrication system (5) supply motion and protect heavily loaded moving parts. Machine design determines the method of adjusting the discharge clearance.

Working—detailed theory

Feed enters the annular space and descends under gravity. As the mantle gyrates towards one portion of the concave, that local clearance decreases. Particles in this zone are compressed and broken between the mantle and the stationary liner. At the same instant, clearance on the opposite side is increasing, so material there is released and can move down.

The closing and opening zones travel around the chamber with the eccentric motion. Fragments therefore undergo repeated compression at successively lower positions, rather than waiting for the whole chamber to open together. Once sufficiently small for the annular discharge, the product leaves continuously around the lower region. This distributed action explains the relatively continuous throughput compared with a jaw crusher.

The operating result depends on feed distribution, discharge clearance, material strength and liner wear. The mantle’s gyration provides the crushing action; the fixed shell itself does not rotate to carry material. Explain this distinction clearly when drawing the shaft, eccentric and annular outlet.

Applications

  • Large-throughput primary crushing of hard rock/mineral feed.

Limitations and safety

  • Large installation/maintenance load; not interchangeable with a jaw. Clearing/lubrication work requires full isolation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fixed concave shellની અંદર gyrating mantleવાળું continuous compression crusher.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Eccentric motionથી annular ભાગો વારાફરતી સાંકડા/પહોળા થાય; પરિઘ પર સતત crushing.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Fixed concave-lined shell (1)ની અંદર conical head/mantle (2) હોવાથી annular crushing chamber બને છે. મજબૂત main shaft પર mantle હોય અને bearing/support arrangement (4) તેને ટેકો આપે. Feed shaftની આસપાસ ઉપરથી આવે અને નીચેના annular opening (6)માંથી product જાય. Replaceable liners crushing surfacesને wearથી બચાવે છે.

Eccentric sleeve (3) shaftના નીચેના ભાગને નાનકડા circular pathમાં ચલાવે છે. તેથી fixed concaveની અંદર mantle gyrate થાય; માત્ર સ્થિર centre પર cone ફરતો રહે તેવી ક્રિયા નથી. Enclosed drive/lubrication (5) motion આપે તથા heavily loaded moving parts બચાવે. Discharge clearance adjust કરવાની રીત machine design પ્રમાણે હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Feed annular spaceમાં આવી gravityથી ઊતરે છે. Mantle concaveની એક બાજુ નજીક જાય ત્યારે ત્યાંની clearance ઘટે છે. આ વિસ્તારમાં particles mantle તથા stationary liner વચ્ચે compressionથી તૂટે છે. તે જ સમયે સામેની બાજુ clearance વધે છે એટલે ત્યાં material છૂટું પડી નીચે સરકી શકે છે.

Eccentric motion સાથે closing/opening zones chamberની આસપાસ આગળ વધે છે. તેથી આખો chamber એકસાથે ખૂલે તેની રાહ વિના fragments નીચેના સ્થાનો પર વારંવાર compress થાય છે. Annular discharge જેટલા નાના થતાં fragments બહાર જાય છે. આ ફરતા crushing zonesથી jaw crusherની સરખામણીએ વધુ continuous throughput મળે છે.

Feed distribution, discharge clearance, material strength તથા liner wearથી પરિણામ બદલાય છે. Crushing action mantleની gyrationથી મળે; fixed shell material વહન કરવા ફરતો નથી. Shaft, eccentric તથા annular outlet દોરતી વખતે આ તફાવત સ્પષ્ટ સમજાવવો.

ઉપયોગો

  • વધુ throughputવાળા hard rock/mineralનું primary crushing.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • મોટું installation/maintenance; જૉ જેવું નથી. Clearing/lubrication પહેલાં સંપૂર્ણ isolation.

body.en:
Definition

A crusher using opposing rotating rolls to draw and compress solids through a controlled gap.

Principle

  • Friction draws a particle into the nip; compression then reduces its size.

Construction—detailed theory

Two horizontal rolls (1) are mounted parallel to each other in a strong bearing frame (3). Their surfaces may be smooth or profiled for the selected duty. An adjustable arrangement controls the minimum gap between the rolls (4). The feed hopper spreads solids above this gap and the discharge chute collects material below (6).

The drive (2) turns the rolls in opposite directions so that both surfaces at the nip move downward. In suitable designs, one roll is mounted with spring or other engineered overload relief (5), permitting limited movement when an excessive load occurs. Guards enclose drives and nip regions. Roll diameter, width, surface condition and gap are important construction parameters.

Working—detailed theory

A metered feed reaches the space above the rolls. Contact friction acts tangentially between each roll and the particle and tends to draw it into the nip, while normal forces tend to push it away. Capture occurs only if the available friction and nip geometry allow the inward components to overcome the outward components.

After capture, the downward-moving surfaces carry the particle into progressively smaller clearance. Compression breaks the particle and the fragments pass through the minimum gap. The rotating surfaces then separate below the nip and the product falls into the discharge chute. Rolls should not be described as applying only impact: compression is the principal mechanism in the smooth-roll example.

Gap and roll speed influence output, but maximum capturable feed size also depends on roll diameter and friction. A particle may be too large to be gripped even if it could later be broken. Engineered relief protects against abnormal loads; it is not permission to feed incompatible tramp material or clear a running nip.

Applications

  • Secondary crushing and controlled reduction where excessive fines are undesirable.

Limitations and safety

  • Hardness, abrasion, feed lumps and moisture limit performance. Nip points must remain inaccessible.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

વિરુદ્ધ ફરતા rollsથી solidને ખેંચી નિયંત્રિત gapમાં દબાવતું crusher.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Frictionથી particle nipમાં ખેંચાય; પછી compressionથી કદ ઘટે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

બે horizontal rolls (1) મજબૂત bearing frame (3)માં એકબીજાને parallel હોય છે. Duty મુજબ surfaces smooth કે profiled હોય છે. Adjustable arrangementથી rolls વચ્ચે minimum gap (4) નક્કી થાય છે. Hopper gap ઉપર feed ફેલાવે અને નીચેની discharge chute (6) product ભેગો કરે છે.

Drive (2) rollsને વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં એવી રીતે ફેરવે કે nip પાસે બંને surfaces નીચે તરફ જાય. Suitable designમાં એક rollને spring/engineered overload relief (5) મળે છે જેથી excessive loadમાં મર્યાદિત movement થઈ શકે. Drive/nip regions guarded હોય છે. Diameter, width, surface condition તથા gap અગત્યનાં construction parameters છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Metered feed rolls ઉપર આવે છે. Roll-particle contactનું tangential friction particleને nipમાં ખેંચે, જ્યારે normal forces તેને બહાર ધકેલવાની અસર કરે છે. Available friction તથા nip geometryમાં inward components પૂરતા હોય ત્યારે જ particle પકડાય છે.

પકડાયેલ particle downward-moving surfaces સાથે ઓછી થતી clearanceમાં આવે છે. Compressionથી તે તૂટે અને fragments minimum gapમાંથી પસાર થાય છે. Nipની નીચે surfaces છૂટાં પડતાં product chuteમાં પડે છે. Smooth-roll exampleમાં મુખ્ય mechanism compression છે; માત્ર impact લખવું ખોટું છે.

Gap/speed outputને અસર કરે, પરંતુ maximum capturable feed size diameter/friction પર પણ આધાર રાખે છે. Particle તોડી શકાય એવો હોવા છતાં nip તેને પકડી ન શકે. Relief abnormal load માટે છે; incompatible tramp material નાખવા કે running nip clear કરવાની મંજૂરી નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Secondary crushing તથા વધુ fines અનિચ્છનીય હોય ત્યાં controlled reduction.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Hardness, abrasion, lumps/moisture મર્યાદા લાવે. Nip point સુધી પહોંચવું નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A rotating cylindrical mill in which grinding media reduce solids by impact and attrition.

Principle

  • Balls are lifted and then cascade/cataract; relative motion and falling media fracture/abrade feed.

Construction—detailed theory

The main body is a horizontal cylindrical shell with a wear-resistant lining (1). Grinding balls (2) occupy only part of its internal volume, leaving space for feed, media motion and product. Bearings/supports (6) carry the shell, while a guarded gear, roller or other drive (3) rotates it. The lining protects the shell and helps lift the charge.

Feed enters through the designed connection (4); wet operation additionally uses a compatible liquid. The outlet (5) may use a grate or an overflow arrangement according to mill design. Media size, filling, internal lined diameter and speed determine the charge motion. The drawing is an end-view concept; actual feed/discharge passages extend along the mill axis.

Working—detailed theory

As the shell rotates, friction between lining and charge lifts balls on the rising side. Below the theoretical critical speed, gravity eventually causes elevated balls to roll or fall back. Cascading balls produce rolling and attrition, while balls falling through larger trajectories provide impact. Useful grinding comes from this relative motion, not from balls merely remaining fixed against the shell.

Feed trapped between balls or between balls and lining is repeatedly stressed and broken. The bed is continually redistributed as the media circulate, allowing fresh particles to enter contact zones. In wet grinding, liquid carries the suspended product towards the outlet; in a suitable dry system, the designed discharge and downstream handling remove the product.

Residence time, ball size, filling and speed govern the size distribution. At the ideal critical condition a ball can remain against the wall at the top, reducing falling action; hence the normal grinding speed is a selected fraction of critical speed. This is a calculation concept, not an instruction to experimentally overspeed a trainer.

Applications

  • Fine grinding of ores, pigments and suitable wet/dry solids.

Limitations and safety

  • Excess speed can centrifuge balls and reduce useful impact; wear/contamination matter. Never seek critical speed on an unapproved trainer.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ફરતા cylindrical millમાં grinding mediaથી impact/attrition દ્વારા કદ ઘટે.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Balls ઊંચા જઈ cascade/cataract થાય; પડતાં/ખસતાં mediaથી fracture/abrasion થાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

મુખ્ય body horizontal cylindrical shell તથા wear-resistant lining (1)થી બને છે. Grinding balls (2) અંદરનો અમુક ભાગ જ ભરે છે જેથી feed, media motion તથા product માટે જગ્યા રહે. Bearings/supports (6) shellને ટેકો આપે; guarded gear/roller drive (3) તેને ફેરવે છે. Lining shell બચાવે તથા chargeને ઊંચકવામાં મદદ કરે છે.

Designed connection (4)થી feed આવે; wet operationમાં compatible liquid પણ હોય છે. Design મુજબ outlet (5) grate કે overflow પ્રકારનો હોય છે. Media size, filling, lined internal diameter તથા speedથી charge motion નક્કી થાય. આકૃતિ end-view concept છે; actual feed/discharge passages millની axis તરફ હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Shell ફરતાં lining-charge frictionથી rising side પર balls ઊંચા જાય છે. Theoretical critical speedની નીચે gravityથી balls પાછા roll/fall થાય છે. Cascadingથી rolling/attrition અને ઊંચા trajectoryમાંથી પડવાથી impact મળે છે. Balls shell સાથે સ્થિર ચોંટેલા રહે તેનાથી નહીં, આ relative motionથી useful grinding થાય છે.

Balls વચ્ચે કે ball-lining વચ્ચે ફસાયેલ feed વારંવાર stressથી તૂટે છે. Media circulate થતાં bed ફરી ગોઠવાય અને નવા particles contact zonesમાં આવે છે. Wet grindingમાં liquid suspended productને outlet તરફ વહાવે; dry systemમાં designed discharge તથા downstream handling product દૂર કરે છે.

Residence time, ball size, filling/speed product distributionને અસર કરે છે. Ideal critical conditionમાં top પર ball wall પાસે ટકી શકે એટલે falling action ઘટે; તેથી normal grinding speed critical speedનો પસંદ કરેલો fraction હોય છે. આ calculation concept છે; trainerને overspeed કરવાનું સૂચન નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Ore, pigment તથા યોગ્ય wet/dry solidsનું fine grinding.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • વધુ speedએ balls centrifuge થઈ impact ઘટે; wear/contamination મહત્વનાં. Unapproved trainer પર critical speed નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An impact mill using rapidly moving hammers in an enclosed grinding chamber.

Principle

  • Hammer impacts and subsequent contacts fracture feed; the outlet screen controls which material can escape.

Construction—detailed theory

An enclosed casing forms the grinding chamber and has a controlled feed chute (1). A horizontal rotor shaft carries fixed or hinged hammers (2). Replaceable breaker surfaces (3) line selected parts of the chamber, while a perforated screen (4) covers the intended outlet region. Its openings influence which fragments can escape.

The guarded motor drive and bearings (5) maintain the rotor motion. Below the screen, a product outlet (6) directs material to an enclosed collector; suitable dust extraction is part of the installation where required. Hammer clearance, rotor diameter and screen area are selected for the material. The screen is a retaining surface, not a separate source of power.

Working—detailed theory

Metered feed enters the path of the rapidly moving hammers. Direct impacts accelerate and fracture particles, which may then strike breaker surfaces or other particles. Larger fragments remain in the chamber and receive further blows. Repeated high-rate stressing makes impact the principal reduction mechanism, with some rubbing and attrition also possible.

Fragments small enough and suitably oriented pass through the perforated screen and enter the product outlet. Oversized pieces are retained for additional reduction, so the screen and residence history together influence product size. A screen aperture does not mean that every escaping particle has exactly that diameter, particularly for elongated particles.

Sticky feed can blind the screen, and hard abrasive material can rapidly wear hammers and liners. These changes alter capacity, heat generation and size distribution. Feed control and compatible material selection are therefore essential. Blockages require shutdown and isolation, never reaching through the chute towards the rotating hammers.

Applications

  • Impact reduction of suitable brittle/fibrous materials; selection depends on abrasion and moisture.

Limitations and safety

  • Heat, dust, noise and tramp metal can be serious hazards. No guard opening or hand feeding near the rotor.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Enclosed chamberમાં ઝડપથી ફરતા hammersથી impact grinding કરતું mill.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Hammer impact/પછીના contactથી fracture; outlet screen કયો material બહાર જાય તે નિયંત્રિત કરે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Enclosed casing grinding chamber બનાવે અને controlled feed chute (1) ધરાવે છે. Rotor shaft પર fixed/hinged hammers (2) હોય છે. Chamberના નિર્ધારિત ભાગમાં replaceable breaker surfaces (3) તથા outlet region પર perforated screen (4) હોય છે. Screen openingsથી કયા fragments બહાર નીકળી શકે તે અસર પામે છે.

Guarded motor drive/bearings (5) rotor ચલાવે છે. Screenની નીચે product outlet (6) materialને enclosed collectorમાં પહોંચાડે; જરૂર મુજબ suitable dust extraction હોય છે. Material પ્રમાણે hammer clearance, rotor diameter/screen area પસંદ થાય છે. Screen retaining surface છે; તે અલગ power source નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Metered feed ઝડપથી ફરતા hammersના pathમાં આવે છે. Direct impactથી particles accelerate/fracture થાય; પછી breaker surfaces કે બીજા particles સાથે અથડાઈ શકે. મોટા fragments chamberમાં રહી ફરી blows લે છે. તેથી મુખ્ય mechanism impact છે; થોડું rubbing/attrition પણ થઈ શકે છે.

પૂરતા નાના તથા યોગ્ય orientationવાળા fragments screenમાંથી product outletમાં જાય છે. Oversize વધારાની reduction માટે અંદર રહે; તેથી screen અને residence history બંને sizeને અસર કરે છે. ખાસ elongated particlesમાં દરેક escaping particleનો diameter screen aperture જેટલો જ હોય એવું નથી.

Sticky feedથી screen blind થાય; hard abrasive materialથી hammers/liners ઝડપથી wear થાય. તેથી capacity, heat generation તથા size distribution બદલાય છે. Compatible material/controlled feeding જરૂરી છે. Blockageમાં shutdown/isolation કરવું; chuteમાંથી rotating hammers તરફ હાથ નહીં પહોંચાડવો.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય brittle/fibrous materialsમાં impact reduction; abrasion/moisture મુજબ પસંદગી.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Heat, dust, noise/tramp metal જોખમી. Guard ખોલવો કે rotor પાસે હાથથી feed નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

The full nip angle θ is the angle between the two roll-contact tangents; α=θ/2 is used in the symmetric force/geometric derivation.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume equal smooth rolls of radius R and diameter D, a spherical feed particle of radius r and diameter d, full gap s, and symmetric limiting Coulomb friction μ.Let full nip angle θ=2α.
  2. At each contact, normal force N has outward vertical component N sinα.Friction μN acts down the contact tangent and has inward component μN cosα.
  3. For capture, 2μN cosα≥2N sinα.Cancel2N cosα to obtain tanα≤μ; at the maximum capturable condition αlim=tan⁻¹μ.
  4. The line joining one roll centre to the particle centre has length R+r.Its horizontal projection to the symmetry plane is R+s/2.
  5. Thus cosα=(R+s/2)/(R+r)=(D+s)/(D+d), so θ=2cos⁻¹[(D+s)/(D+d)].Use consistent length units.
  6. At limiting capture, D+dmax=(D+s)/cos(tan⁻¹μ).Using1/cos(tan⁻¹μ)=√(1+μ²), dmax=(D+s)√(1+μ²)−D.
  7. Check the actual required tanα against μ before claiming capture.This ideal quasi-static derivation neglects detailed weight, dynamics, irregular shapes and wear; it is not a roll-strength design.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બંને roll-contact tangents વચ્ચેનો પૂર્ણ કોણ θ nip angle; સમતુલિત derivationમાં α=θ/2 લો.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Equal smooth rolls R/D, spherical particle r/d, full gap s, symmetric Coulomb friction μ માનો.Full nip angle θ=2α રાખો.
  2. દર contactનું normal N outward vertical component N sinα આપે.Friction μN tangent પર નીચે લાગીને inward component μN cosα આપે.
  3. Capture માટે2μN cosα≥2N sinα; 2N cosα cancel કરતાં tanα≤μ.Maximum conditionમાં αlim=tan⁻¹μ.
  4. Roll centreથી particle centre સુધી R+r; આ lineનું symmetry plane તરફ horizontal projection R+s/2 છે.
  5. અેથી cosα=(R+s/2)/(R+r)=(D+s)/(D+d); θ=2cos⁻¹[(D+s)/(D+d)].Length units સમાન રાખો.
  6. Limiting captureમાં D+dmax=(D+s)/cos(tan⁻¹μ).Identityથી dmax=(D+s)√(1+μ²)−D.
  7. Capture કહેતાં પહેલાં actual tanα તથા μ સરખાવો.Ideal quasi-static તારવણીમાં detailed weight, dynamics, irregular shape/wear નથી; આ roll-strength design નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Critical speed is the ideal threshold at which a ball can remain against the shell at the top instead of falling.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Let internal lined mill diameter be D and ball diameter d in metres.The ball centre travels at radius rc=R−r=(D−d)/2 from the mill axis.
  2. At the top, the inward direction is vertically down.Ball weight mg and the inward wall normal reaction Nw together supply centripetal force:mω²rc=mg+Nw.
  3. At the ideal threshold for just maintaining contact, Nw=0.Therefore mωc²rc=mg; cancel m to obtain ωc=√(g/rc).
  4. Convert angular speed to rpm:ωc=2πNc/60, so Nc=(60/2π)√[2g/(D−d)].
  5. With g≈9.81m/s², the coefficient is approximately42.3.Final result:Nc≈42.3/√(D−d) rpm, with D, d in metres.
  6. If operating fraction is f, Nop=fNc.For a stated percentage p, Nop=(p/100)Nc.Explain that useful cascading requires relative media motion.
  7. State the ideal single-ball assumptions and do not use product size instead of ball size.Calculated Nc is not permission for a student overspeed test.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ball ઉપરના સ્થાનેથી નીચે પડવાને બદલે shell સાથે રહી શકે તે ideal threshold critical speed છે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Internal lined mill diameter D, ball diameter d metresમાં લો.Ball centreનો path radius rc=R−r=(D−d)/2.
  2. Top પર inward direction નીચે છે.Weight mg તથા inward wall reaction Nw મળીને centripetal force આપે:mω²rc=mg+Nw.
  3. Just-contact ideal thresholdમાં Nw=0; તેથી mωc²rc=mg.Mass cancel કરતાં ωc=√(g/rc).
  4. Angular speedને rpmમાં:ωc=2πNc/60; તેથી Nc=(60/2π)√[2g/(D−d)].
  5. g≈9.81m/s²થી coefficient≈42.3.Final:Nc≈42.3/√(D−d) rpm, D/d metresમાં.
  6. Operating fraction f હોય તો Nop=fNc; p% માટે Nop=(p/100)Nc.Useful cascadingમાં relative media motion જરૂરી છે.
  7. Ideal single-ball assumptions આપો; dમાં product size નહીં, ball size લો.Nc calculation student overspeed testની મંજૂરી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Open-circuit product leaves without size-based recycle; closed-circuit grinding uses a classifier/screen to return coarse material.

Explanation

  • Open circuit is simpler but residence time alone controls size poorly; unnecessary fine grinding may occur.
  • Closed circuit separates fine product while returning oversize, improving control but adding separator, recycle load and energy/maintenance.
  • At steady state fresh feed equals final product if losses are negligible; mill feed equals fresh plus recycle. Do not equate recycle with new production.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Open circuitમાં size-based recycle નથી; closed circuitમાં classifier/screen coarse material પાછું મોકલે.

સમજણ

  • Open circuit સરળ, પણ માત્ર residence timeથી size control મર્યાદિત; વધુ fine grinding થઈ શકે.
  • Closed circuit fine product કાઢી oversize પાછું આપે; control સુધરે પણ separator, recycle load, energy/maintenance વધે.
  • Steady state અને loss ન હોય તો fresh feed=final product; mill feed=fresh+recycle. Recycleને નવું production ન ગણો.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Given F=4mm, P=1mm, E=6kWh/t; E=KR(1/P−1/F).

To find

Fit KR, then find energy and net power for the new product size.

Governing relation and assumptions

Rittinger:E=KR(1/P−1/F).Use a constant calibrated for the same material, size units and energy basis; Pnet=QE.

Calculation with substitution

  1. KR=6/(1−0.25)=8kWh·mm/t.
  2. For the same feed and conditions, P=0.5mm:E=8(2−0.25)=14kWh/t.
  3. At 2t/h, net grinding power=14×2=28kW; motor input needs losses/efficiency.

Final answer

KR=8kWh·mm/t; new E=14kWh/t; at2t/h, Pnet=28kW.

Unit/physical check

Finer product requires larger energy within the model; kWh/t×t/h=kW.This is not automatically motor input.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

F=4mm, P=1mm, E=6kWh/t; E=KR(1/P−1/F).

શું શોધવું

KR fit કરી નવા product માટે energy/net power શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

Rittinger:E=KR(1/P−1/F).સમાન material, size units/energy basisનો constant; Pnet=QE.

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. KR=6/(1−0.25)=8kWh·mm/t.
  2. સમાન feed/conditionsમાં P=0.5mm:E=8(2−0.25)=14kWh/t.
  3. 2t/h પર net grinding power=28kW; motor inputમાં losses/efficiency જોઈએ.

અંતિમ જવાબ

KR=8kWh·mm/t; નવું E=14kWh/t; 2t/hમાં Pnet=28kW.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

Modelમાં finer productને વધુ energy જોઈએ; kWh/t×t/h=kW.આ આપમેળે motor input નથી.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

At reduction ratio F/P=4, E=3kWh/t; E=KK ln(F/P).

To find

Fit KK, then predict energy and power at reduction ratio8.

Governing relation and assumptions

Kick:E=KK ln(F/P); KK=Etest/lnRtest; Pnet=QE.Keep the natural-log convention.

Calculation with substitution

  1. KK=3/ln4=2.1640kWh/t.
  2. For F/P=8, E=2.1640ln8=4.50kWh/t.
